description: Entra directory facts for per-employee entitlements through the GET-only Graph client: one enabled user's object (accountEnabled, UPN, department) and complete transitive group membership, or, when the membership read is refused for consent, the M365 groups of the user's joined Teams, and the approver roster's Entra object ids resolved by UPN (operating/approver_roster.json, nothing written); counts and enums only, never an id, name or address.
notes: Live-unverified for group_basis (added with the joined-Teams fallback). group_basis transitive: the membership read succeeded (the result at main ee84ff16, 2026-10-07T03:49Z, read it: directory_status read, group_count 3); joined_teams: the membership read was refused (graph_permission_missing:GroupMember.Read.All) and the groups were derived from joinedTeams; none: neither was read, no group. Each listing is all pages or nothing. The check requires group_listing_read 1 (group_basis transitive or joined_teams): group_basis none (membership refused and joinedTeams unreadable) denies every employee rights_unresolved, so it fails the check rather than passing on directory_status read. Roster resolution (GOV-09): every approver roster entry is read once by its UPN (graph.user); roster_resolved counts those that answered as exactly that enabled user, roster_reason is the first refusal (none, user_not_found, user_mismatch, account_disabled, graph_permission_missing:User.Read.All, unreadable:<detail>). The check requires the roster to be read (roster_entries >= 1) and records the count; it does not require it to resolve, so a UPN that differs from the roster key shows as roster_reason user_not_found rather than failing the directory check. Blocked: a read Graph answers 403 with its permission-refusal code (Authorization_RequestDenied or ErrorAccessDenied, integrations.graph_read.probe_block) is a top-level blocked_upstream part in capture_mail.graph_block's shape (error_code missing_permission, cause host_misconfiguration, the application permission it needs); expect_blocked then applies and the check reads blocked, never pass. Any other failure (401, a 403 with another code or none, 5xx, transport, a malformed answer) still fails. The refused part: the user listing (directory.user_listing, User.Read.All); no user is read, the roster is still read and every approver's graph.user read must be refused for the same grant (roster_reason graph_permission_missing:User.Read.All, roster_refused == roster_entries), so an approver read failing otherwise (5xx, transport, not found) or resolving beside the refusal reads fail; the command exits 1 (ok false). expect_blocked asks for no positive quantity: nothing the check measures was read, so it is blocked, never measured. Expected while consent graph-mail-directory-consent is outstanding (live 2026-10-19: /users 403 authorization_request_denied): blocked_upstream [{part directory.user_listing, http_status 403, error_code missing_permission, permission User.Read.All}].
